title: 📅 Swap your old Halloween costumes at Putterham Library
text:
21 hours ago 📅 Halloween Costume Swap at Putterham Library
Clean out the dress-up bin and help another family get ready for Halloween.
Bring your gently used costumes, accessories, and decorations to Putterham Library and swap them for something “new to you.” Items for kids, adults, and even pets are welcome.
You don’t have to donate to look through the swap and take something home, but donating is encouraged if you can.
Donations accepted starting: September 23 Donation drop-off location: Front desk at Putterham Library Event type: In-person Halloween costume swap Perfect if you’ve outgrown last year’s costume or just want to save money and cut down on waste.
